name: Protein Structure Generation Agent
description: Generates 2D scientific visualizations of proteins and species traits using FLUX.2-pro. Routes to Trait Discovery when morphological, physiological, behavioral, functional, or structural traits are not yet available in context.
capabilities: Orchestrator routing for missing trait interpretation

input.context: dict with species, protein/gene identifiers, and traits from Trait Discovery Agent

output.traits_used: list of trait strings used for the visualization
